C-CAMPAIGN-NAME-PREFIX-ROOT-ENV-20261118.Summary: Prefix every created campaign name with a configurable test_lastname_ prefix and move environment files to the repository root.
C-CAMPAIGN-NAME-PREFIX-ROOT-ENV-20261118.Problem: Campaigns in the shared test tracker must be named test_ponomaryov_*, e.g. test_ponomaryov_campaign1, and the env files live inside apps/backend instead of the repository root.

Goals.Goal: New setting CAMPAIGN_NAME_PREFIX (root .env: test_ponomaryov_); the creator prepends it to the requested name unless the name already starts with it.
API contract: CreatorDefaults gains campaign_name_prefix (string) so the UI can show the prefix next to the name field.
Env files move to the repository root (.env, .env.example); docker compose and local backend runs both read the root .env.
Existing tool-created campaign 214527 is renamed in Keitaro and in created_campaigns to the prefixed name.

Constraints.Constraint: Root .env stays gitignored; .env.example contains only placeholders.
Tests are banned; evidence is the static gates and a live creator run.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No renaming of campaigns not created by this tool; no prefix enforcement in the offer editor.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: POST /api/campaigns {name: campaign1} creates a Keitaro campaign named test_ponomaryov_campaign1; a name already starting with the prefix is not doubled.
GET /api/reference/defaults returns campaign_name_prefix; the creator form shows it before the name input.
apps/backend/.env and apps/backend/.env.example no longer exist; make up and make backend work with the root .env.
gate-backend, gate-frontend, gate-openapi, gate-compose and grace lint exit 0.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Gate output, contract diff showing campaign_name_prefix, live creation of test_ponomaryov_* campaign.

Assumptions.Assumption: Requested by the user in chat on 2026-11-18 (prefix test_ponomaryov_, env files in root).
